dedupe_keys.name: real time wastewater monitoring as tool to detect clandestine waste discharges into the sewage system

description: Supplementary PDFs and videos document tests for detecting illegal wastewater discharges using chloride, pH and conductivity sensors in flowing sewage. Waste dilution and discharge timing were varied in controlled experiments. This resource is provided by Frank M. Hauser; Tim Metzner; Thorsten Rößler and coauthors. Coverage is site as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists MP4, PDF formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC BY 4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: These are supplementary research materials, not an established live monitoring feed. Detection of household connections requires sufficiently frequent sampling. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-iwa-benchmark-simulation-models. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
